title: SCA Young Adult Division: Hiking With Heroes Keynote Speaker- Maya Shaposhnik Cadena

chapters.title: Introduction and Background
chapters.about: Maya introduces herself and her upbringing in Los Angeles.

chapters.title: Moving to Israel and Military Service
chapters.about: Joining the military as a lone soldier and training in the desert.

chapters.title: Founding a Company
chapters.about: Creating an events company for internationals while in the military.

chapters.title: Working for APAC
chapters.about: Joining the pro-Israel lobby and starting a Sephardic division.

summary: Maya Shaposhnik Cadena shares her personal story of moving from Los Angeles to Israel to serve in the military as a lone soldier. She discusses her experiences in the military, her professional work with APAC, and how she navigated challenges on campus during business school by leveraging her background and community identity.
questions: What was the hardest part of living in Israel?
How did you and your friends move to Israel together?
What gave you the drive to join the military?
Did you ever consider building your family in Israel?
